blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Look around you. The office already speaks English! The Czarnikow office is full of useful words: meeting rooms, chairs, tables, windows and doors.

Today we describe the office. We use there is for one thing. We use there are for more than one thing. For example: there is a window near my desk, and there are five chairs at the table.

Take your time. Every sentence counts. Today we learn five useful words and we practise a lot.

items.q: What is the office full of?
items.why: "The Czarnikow office is full of useful words."

items.q: We use "there is" for…
items.why: "We use there is for one thing."

items.q: How many chairs are there at the table in the example?
items.why: "there are five chairs at the table."

items.q: The text says "take your time." This suggests that the author wants you to…
items.why: Inferência: "take your time" e "every sentence counts" mostram um tom calmo e paciente.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: English is all around us at work
the office has nothing to learn from
we must leave the office to learn English
words in the office are not useful
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz "the office already speaks English" e está cheio de palavras úteis.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver mostrando o escritório. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello! I am Oliver. Welcome to our office. Come with me. I will show you the room.

Look. There is a big table in the middle. There are eight chairs around the table. This is our meeting room. There is a window here, and the window is very big. There is a lot of light in the morning.

Now look at the wall. There is a clock on the wall. There is a small door next to the clock. That door goes to the kitchen. In the kitchen there is a coffee machine. I like coffee very much!

There are three computers on my desk. My desk is near the window. There are many traders in this office. Today there are ten people in the team, but two people are at home.

Take your time. Look around. There is a lot of English here. See you soon!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How many chairs are there around the table?
items.why: "There are eight chairs around the table."

items.q: Where is the clock?
items.why: "There is a clock on the wall."

items.q: What is in the kitchen?
items.why: "In the kitchen there is a coffee machine."

items.q: The team has ten people, but only eight are there today. This suggests that…
options: two people are working from home
items.why: Inferência: "two people are at home", então dez menos dois dá oito presentes.

items.q: How does Oliver feel about the office?
options: He is proud and happy to show it
He does not like the office
items.why: Inferência: ele diz "Welcome", "Come with me" e "I like coffee very much" — tom simpático e positivo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please close the door when you leave." A door is…
items.why: Door = porta.

items.q: "I sit on this chair every day." A chair is…
items.why: Chair = cadeira.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "There is a big ___ near my desk, so I can see the street."
items.why: Window = janela, por onde você vê a rua.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "There are five chairs at the ___ in the meeting room."
items.why: Table = mesa: as cadeiras ficam ao redor da mesa.

items.q: "We have a meeting in room 3." A room is…
items.why: Room = sala.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e verbos simples do dia a dia no escritório. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Come in and sit down, please." To sit down means to…
items.why: Sit down = sentar-se.

items.q: "Please have a seat, the meeting starts now." This means…
items.why: Have a seat = sente-se (forma educada).

items.q: "Can you turn on the light? The room is dark." To turn on means to…
items.why: Turn on = ligar (a luz, a máquina).

items.q: "Come in, the door is open!" To come in means to…
items.why: Come in = entrar.

items.q: "Let's take a break and get some coffee." To take a break means to…
options: stop work for a short time
items.why: Take a break = fazer uma pausa.
